attributes.name: Flat-Coated Retriever
attributes.description: The Flat-Coated Retriever is a large breed of retrieving dog from England. These dogs are large in size, with a flat and glossy coat of fur. They have a lively and affectionate demeanor, making them excellent companion and working dogs. They are highly trainable and intelligent, with an instinct to retrieve game. They are loyal and devoted to their family, with an independent nature that makes them well suited for retrieving and guard work.
